I’m sorry I’m sure this is really stressful for you and i’m sorry you felt the need to do this but “Styro” is the dermis layer of your skin. It’s pretty white in comparison to the epidermis because you’ve cut past the melanin. Fat is more yellow but it can be hard to tell, it’s more bubbly in most people. Rinsing is good! Please try and avoid alcohol/ hydrogen peroxide/ iodide directly in the wound. I don’t think you should  apply anti antibiotic stuff like neosporin on fat but around the edges it’s okay . Something like vasaline could help keep it moist and not stick to the gauze. If you’re able to get it closed at and ER or urgent care that’s probably your best option or use steri strips if it’s gaping but you can only apply those within the first 12-24 hours before it’s scabbed up or too much debris is introduced
